items.title: Todoist confirms 6% of customers’ details were stolen in data breach
items.summary: Todoist said a hacker gained access to its production systems and stole customer data, including email IDs, password hashes, and account creation dates.
items.creator: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
items.summary: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.
items.creator: Lauren Forristal
